svg.title: Provincial Signature—Colour; positive/reverse
svg.desc: Historical reconstruction from the supplied Visual Identity Program manuals. Fixed artwork is scan-derived. Live Helvetica-compatible preview text is editable but not font-certified. Geometry not explicitly printed in the source is a reconstruction choice, not a newly asserted historical standard. Hybrid page: original illustrations and fine labels remain raster where identified in the page manifest.
